versions.content: For intra-partition communication with explicit dataSendPoint the DataSendCompletedEvent shall be fired if and only if the sending to all receivers has been performed. The transmission status shall be RTE_E_TRANSMIT_ACK and can be collected with Rte_Feedback API.
